description: Issue #27 follow-up: FNDSTRPDM with the real keywords (IBM Docs: OPTION *NONE needs PRTMBRLIST(*YES)/PRTRCDS; CASE *IGNORE/*MATCH) run non-interactively in the wrapper job; copies QSYSPRT to VFYSPL if that is the spool name, and lists the author's own spool entries to learn the actual printer file name. Read-only against the source members; only VFYSPL in &LIB is written.

steps.label: VSPLPF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYSPL) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) RCDLEN(133) TEXT('verify harness spooled-file text capture'))

steps.label: FND1
steps.cmd: FNDSTRPDM FILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) MBR(*ALL) STRING('tokuim') OPTION(*NONE) PRTMBRLIST(*YES) PRTRCDS(*ALL)

steps.label: CAP1
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.label: FND2
steps.cmd: FNDSTRPDM FILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) MBR(*ALL) STRING('tokuim') OPTION(*NONE) CASE(*MATCH) PRTMBRLIST(*YES)

steps.label: CAP2
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.sql: SELECT * FROM &LIB/VFYSPL FETCH FIRST 150 ROWS ONLY
SELECT SPOOLED_FILE_NAME, JOB_NAME, FILE_NUMBER, TOTAL_PAGES, CREATE_TIMESTAMP FROM QSYS2.OUTPUT_QUEUE_ENTRIES WHERE USER_NAME = CURRENT_USER ORDER BY CREATE_TIMESTAMP DESC FETCH FIRST 12 ROWS ONLY
